units.source_text: 我从漱清亭旁走到金阁西侧的板门，

en.t: I walked from beside Sosei-tei to the wooden door on the west side of the Golden Pavilion,

units.source_text: 纵身跃进两扇敞开的大门内，

en.t: leapt through the two wide-open doors,

units.source_text: 把挟在胳肢南下的坐垫和包袱皮扔在握在一起的行李堆上。

en.t: and threw the cushion and wrapping cloth I had tucked under my arm onto the pile of bundled luggage.
